Messages.Author: hamdamcwa
Messages.Body:
OK V:TES Junkies, here's a couple of questions for yer:

1)What card currently has the most text on it (excluding Flavour text
and the card title)? To qualify, I guess we are looking at the most
words and then characters.

2)Then the opposite: what card has the least text on it?

I was having an idle argument with someone and have a few ideas...

1) Week of Nightmares? 110 words, 465 characters (not counting spaces)

2) Computer Hacking? 5 words, 20 characters

Can these be beat?

Cheers

DH
